ru.credits: Из Windows XP: игра Cinematronics и Maxis (Microsoft). Код игры — открытый проект SpaceCadetPinball (декомпилированная игра, перенесённая на SDL): https://github.com/k4zmu2a/SpaceCadetPinball. Сборка для браузера (WebAssembly) основана на форке https://github.com/alula/SpaceCadetPinball. Данные стола (PINBALL.DAT) взяты из Windows XP.

en.credits: From Windows XP: the game by Cinematronics and Maxis (Microsoft). The game code is the open SpaceCadetPinball project (a decompiled game ported to SDL): https://github.com/k4zmu2a/SpaceCadetPinball. The browser (WebAssembly) build is based on the fork https://github.com/alula/SpaceCadetPinball. The table data (PINBALL.DAT) comes from Windows XP.
